the identification of new agents with selective activity in sarcoma is extremely important.
the development of new agents with specific activity in sarcomatous diseases is still in its infancy.

there are several agents in clinical development that show some biological activity in sarcomatous diseases but none of them have been proven to be superior in efficacy to the conventional chemotherapeutic agents.
The main takeaway from our work is that
sarcomas are a heterogeneous group of tumours that require a different therapeutic approach than that used in solid tumours.
sarcomas represent a heterogeneous disease and the identification of a new drug with activity in one sarcoma type does not necessarily imply its activity in other sarcoma types.
